objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with episodic cough and shortness of breath.

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

“Doctor, I’ve had about a month of intermittent cough and shortness of breath. It’s nonproductive, gets worse when I climb stairs and at night, and started after I had fever, a sore throat, and nasal congestion about 8 weeks ago.”
[ASK] Have you had a persistent cough with shortness of breath that worsens over time (chronic respiratory symptoms)?

“Yes, it’s been about a month and it keeps coming back rather than fully going away. It doesn’t produce any mucus, and the shortness of breath and cough feel worse when I exert myself like climbing stairs and especially at night.”
